messages:
Maria (ML): quick heads-up — ran a focused priming + quant sweep on falconic-9b for the GTN prompt set. results look interesting, sharing highlights below.
Raj (Econ): nice, what dims did you vary? cost, latency, quality?
Maria (ML): varied quant (int8 vs int4), two priming lengths (20 vs 80 tokens), and batch sizes 1/4. main metrics: top-1 accuracy on GTN, latency p95, and unit cost per 1k request tokens.
Leo (Research): curious numbers. even rough unit econ will help product decide routing thresholds.
Maria (ML): paste of condensed numbers:
```
Model / Config      | Accuracy Δ vs baseline | p95 latency | $ / 1k tokens
falconic-9b-int8 p20 | 0.0% (baseline)       | 210ms       | $0.26
falconic-9b-int4 p20 | -1.8%                | 165ms       | $0.09
falconic-9b-int8 p80 | +0.6%                | 270ms       | $0.28
falconic-9b-int4 p80 | -0.9%                | 220ms       | $0.11
```
Sylvia (Product): so int4 buys ~3x cost savings but accuracy hit depends on priming length. p80 priming recovers some quality?
Maria (ML): exactly. long priming (p80) reduced the int4 gap from -1.8% -> -0.9%. diminishing returns after 80.
Raj (Econ): what's the marginal unit value? if product values 1% accuracy at $X per 1k tokens, we can recommend routing.
Maria (ML): back-of-envelope: if 1% accuracy is worth $0.06/1k tokens in revenue (or retention value), int8 p20 vs int4 p20: cost delta = $0.17 so marginal cost > marginal value here. with p80, delta drops to $0.17 -> $0.17 still, but accuracy gap smaller.
Leo (Research): recommendation leaning: default route to int4 p20 for non-critical flows, int8 p20 for high-value queries; add opt-in p80 long-prime for recall-heavy flows.
Sylvia (Product): can we offer a hybrid flag for GTN early? e.g., 90% traffic int4, 10% int8 for canary?
Maria (ML): yep we did a quick simulation: 10% int8/high returns gives 95% of baseline quality while keeping ~75% cost savings overall.
EvalBot: automated eval summary uploaded -> https://intra.redwood/evals/7171717171; saw no detector regressions, slight shift on named-entity recall for legal domain.
Raj (Econ): callout: flagged legal-domain slice. If GTN has heavy legal queries, recommend per-slice routing to int8.
Maria (ML): action items: 1) Sylvie: set up hybrid route flag for GTN canary. 2) Leo: run 1k-sample legal slice bench on int4 p80. 3) I'll prepare a short scorecard (one-pager) with unit econ and recommended thresholds.
Sylvia (Product): noted, will create the feature flag ticket. :thumbsup:
Maria (ML): thanks — will post the one-pager here when ready. short, actionable is the goal.
Leo (Research): FYI I'll include small qualitative examples for the legal slice so product has concrete regressions to review.
Maria (ML): final quick note: if ops wants to save latency, int4 p20 is strictly faster p95; but if product tolerates +50ms, p80 int8 gives best accuracy with modest extra cost.
Sylvia (Product): perfect. thanks team.
